events.name: Jovin Webb
events.info: "The triumph of Jovin Webb's first release hinges on the impressive strength of his singing... an utterly convincing deep-blues voice that seems to be stained by nicotine and marinated in rye whiskey," claims DOWNBEAT. "...one of the most distinctive new voices in modern blues...? says BLUES MAGAZINE (Album Review of 'Son of a Sinner'). "Jovin Webb possesses a great voice, selects great songs, and surrounds himself with great musicians. I believe that he is only witnessing the early stages of what will become a long and successful career," raves BLUES ROCK REVIEW (Album Review of ?Son of a Sinner?).
events.pleaseNote: Louisiana-born Powerhouse Blues, Rock & Soul Singer JOVIN WEBB and his outstanding 5-piece band bring the soul of Baton Rouge to the stage with a voice shaped by gospel, Southern culture, and years of experience. After turning heads on American Idol, Webb released his acclaimed debut album 'Drifter' on Blind Pig Records, produced by multi-GRAMMY® winner Tom Hambridge. His powerful second album, 'Son of a Sinner' (released September 18, 2026), delivers a raw blend of blues, gospel, and Southern rock. Webb has established himself as one of the most compelling young voices in modern blues, with Rock & Blues Muse declaring him "clearly the real deal." Live, he is a commanding performer whose music connects generations through stories of faith, temptation, struggle, and redemption.

Super Session: Wil Blades, Donald Harrison & Mike Clark
events.info: Super Session: Wil Blades, Donald Harrison & Mike ClarkPrepare for a remarkable night of jazz, funk, improvisation, and New Orleans groove as three acclaimed musicians come together for a rare Super Session at Snug Harbor Jazz Bistro. Wil Blades is a dynamic Hammond B-3 organist, composer, and multi-instrumentalist known for his soulful, groove-driven sound. He has performed and recorded with John Scofield, Dr. Lonnie Smith, John Lee Hooker, Charlie Hunter, and Stanton Moore, bringing a distinctive blend of jazz, funk, blues, and New Orleans groove to every performance. A true New Orleans original, Donald Harrison is an internationally celebrated saxophonist, composer, bandleader, and cultural ambassador. A former member of Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers, Harrison has performed and recorded with Miles Davis, Roy Haynes, Ron Carter, Terence Blanchard, and Dr. John. His signature , "rdquo" -> Nouveau Swing" blends jazz with the rhythms and spirit of New Orleans, funk, R&B, hip-hop, and African music. Mike Clark is one of the most influential jazz-funk drummers of his generation, best known for his groundbreaking work with Herbie Hancock and the Headhunters. His playing on Hancock's landmark Thrust, particularly , "rdquo" -> Actual Proof," helped redefine jazz-funk drumming and influenced generations of musicians. Throughout his career, Clark has also performed and recorded with Chet Baker, Wayne Shorter, Joe Henderson, and John Scofield. His dynamic, groove-centered approach has made him a major force in jazz and funk. Together, Blades, Harrison, and Clark bring decades of musical experience and a shared love of improvisation to the Snug Harbor stage. This event is co-sponsored by NOLA x NOLA and features: Wil Blades - hammond B-3 organ Donald Harrison - saxophone Mike Clark - drums Shows at 7:30pm & 9:30pm Doors at 7pm & 9pm Restaurant is Open 5pm - 10pm for dinner before or after your showtime: Advance Ticket Holders can now automatically make dinner table reservations for the Dining Room online via OpenTable.com ! Advance Ticket-Holders can also make table reservations for dinner by Emailing reservations@snugjazz.com after your tickets have been purchased online. Dinner Service without Advance Concert Tickets is first-come, first-served based on availability upon arrival. Kind Reminder: Snug Harbor does NOT serve the full menu inside the Music Room. We do offer cheese and charcuterie tray options. In order to preserve the integrity, quiet and focus of our world class intimate concerts, only the charcuterie, cocktails and soft drinks are available for table service inside the Music Room. However, we encourage you to arrive at least 90 Minutes prior to your showtime in order to enjoy full, relaxing dinner service in the Dining Room right next door, before getting seated in the Music Room for your ticketed showtime.

events.name: Davisito Navarro’s Birthday Party & Album Release with Special Guest Yissy Garcia
events.info: Davisito Navarro's Birthday Party & Album ReleaseCelebrate Cuban jazz, New Orleans groove, and the release of Davisito Navarro's debut album with a special birthday concert at Snug Harbor Jazz Bistro. The CubaNOLA Arts Collective alongside NOLAxNOLA present two stellar performances and an afterparty. A rising star of the next generation of Cuban jazz musicians, Davisito Navarro has performed with leading artists in Cuban music and salsa, including Emilio Morales, Bellita y su Jazztumbatá, El Niño y la Verdad, and José Alberto , "rdquo" -> El Canario." Since moving to New Orleans in 2023, he has become a familiar presence on the city's music scene, performing with the New Orleans Jazz Orchestra, Charlie and the Tropicales, Mariachi Jalisco, Alexey Marti & AfroGumbo, and Delfeayo Marsalis and the Uptown Jazz Orchestra. Yissy Garcia is one of Cuba's most exciting and innovative percussionists. Blending Afro-Cuban rhythms with jazz, funk, R&B, and electronica, she has shared the stage with artists including Dave Matthews, Esperanza Spalding, Allison Russell, Concha Buika, and Joshua Bell. Her performances have been featured at NPR's Tiny Desk, Lincoln Center, the Kennedy Center, SXSW, and other major stages around the country. The evening also celebrates the release of Davisito + El Negro: Live from New Orleans, recorded live, right here at Snug Harbor on September 27, 2026. The album features 10 songs---including five original compositions and fresh interpretations of Cuban and New Orleans classics. After Party begins 11:30 PM with DJ Santero - We'll be celebrating Davisito's birthday after the show with an Afro-Cuban After Party with world renowned DJ Santero. For an extra $10 on the ticket price, keep the celebration going with renowned DJ Santero spinning a high-energy dance mix of Timba, Rumba, Afro-Cubanía, Reparto, and Gozadera---with the best Cuban dance hits from back in the day to present. It will be a who's who of local and visiting Cuban musicians with lots of surprise guests. There's a special discount on the After Party tickets for those who attend the performance. Get both, your performance and after party tickets now! Tonight's engagement is presented in partnership with CubaNOLA Arts Collective and NOLAxNOLA and features: David Navarro - trumpet, timbales, vocal Yissy Garcia - drums, percussion Oscar Rossignoli - piano Alexey Marti - percussion Brent Rose - saxophone Lino Piquero - bass Shows at 7:30pm & 9:30pm Doors at 7:00pm & 9:00pm Afterparty begins at 11:30pm Restaurant is Open 5pm - 10pm for dinner
